research_question: Under the frozen v1.2.1 one-shot protocol with the ONLY treatment difference being RAG OFF -> frozen repository RAG ON, does the definitive cp118 tuned checkpoint (Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct + cp118 PEFT/QLoRA adapter) change its frozen extraction/apply/resolution outcome over the frozen quix40 40-task cohort?

source_baseline.note: S4 starts from the accepted local integration baseline. No S1/D1/S2 branch content is merged or cherry-picked. The live run binds to the committed clean HEAD (source_commit_sha) of this branch after the owner source-freeze commit.

adapter_identity.selection_rule: best surviving saved checkpoint by held-out SWE-rebench validation eval_loss only

model.loading: 4-bit NF4 double-quant base (bitsandbytes), PeftModel.from_pretrained(is_trainable=False), bf16 compute — the established tuned-pilot mechanism

corpus.note: Scoped view of the actual frozen repository revision (byte-identical copies, per-file SHA-256 verified). QuixBugs tests live under python_testcases/, which the frozen repo-mode rule classifies as kind=source (the rule keys on a literal tests/ prefix); provenance records this honestly and retrieval does not filter by kind.

retrieval.frozen_bounds_note: The frozen retrieval bound (MAX_RETRIEVAL_CONTEXT_BYTES=4096) exceeds the frozen agent-context cap (MAX_RAG_CONTEXT_BYTES=4000); RagContext.from_retrieval fails closed on results in (4000,4096]. S4 passes the frozen agent-context cap (4000) as the retrieval bound so the frozen constraints coexist (Amendment 2); reductions are reported explicitly via context_bytes_truncated (never silent). No retrieval parameter is tuned.
retrieval.scoring: integer token-overlap (identifier-aware [a-z0-9_]+), deterministic tie order (score desc, path asc, start_line asc, chunk_id asc)
retrieval.truncation: explicit result_count_truncated / context_bytes_truncated / [query-truncated] marker; never silent

context.injection: additive canonical RagContext.to_request_mapping() block after FAILING_TEST_OUTPUT, before OUTPUT_REQUIREMENTS (deterministic)
context.public_request_byte_budget_scope: LiveModelAdapter agentic public-request mapping only (agentic_debugger/evaluation/live.py); NOT the one-shot generation prompt limit

rag.anti_oracle: task_issue_projection whitelist (task_id/title/description/tags only); gold/fixed code and answer-bearing content structurally absent from the scoped corpus; unit-tested

protocol.name: raw-c9-v1.2.1-oneshot

frozen_sources.note: Untracked frozen protocol sources consumed by S4 at runtime are bound by SHA-256 identity and verified fail-closed before import/use; the raw-pilot directories are not staged.

protocol.tokenizer: AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(base, revision) chat template, add_generation_prompt=True; decode skip_special_tokens=True (frozen)

cohort.name: quix40-v1
cohort.note: Same frozen cohort as the accepted RAW (20/40 apply, 5/40 RESOLVED) and cp118 RAG-OFF (0/40 apply, 0/40 RESOLVED) results

evaluation.primary: exact frozen C9 v1.2.1 CPU evaluation semantics (strict_compliance, extract_patch_semantic_v121, parse_files_independent, parse_symbols_independent, symbol_ground_truth, git apply --check/apply on the frozen revision worktree, pytest on the visible test, truncation rule output_tokens>=4096)
evaluation.f2p: test_pass (supplied-oracle designated visible test) — the frozen RESOLVED basis
evaluation.p2p_reason: the frozen v1.2.1 CPU evaluator never ran pass-to-pass

not_recorded: cp118 RAG-OFF per-task raw evidence (Drive-hosted D7 bundle; accepted aggregates in the master plan)

budgets.retry_scope: infrastructure failures ONLY, applied ONLY BEFORE a valid model completion: transport errors, process/timeout errors, and CUDA out-of-memory (explicitly normalized into the transport-error policy). After a model completion is obtained, persistence/validation failures abort fail-closed and NEVER regenerate. No prompt or retrieval changes on retry.
budgets.timing_truthfulness: OBSERVATIONAL / STOP-POLICY LIMITS — the runner has no hard per-task or campaign wall-clock enforcement mechanism; per-task generation_latency_s and campaign elapsed time are recorded truthfully in the marker/evidence, and the operator enforces the stop policy from the recorded timings. The declared bounds are not claimed as enforced.
budgets.resume_rule: a valid already-completed task in the same run directory is never regenerated (raw/meta/retrieval evidence validated and skipped); incomplete/corrupt partial evidence is never treated as valid (fail closed with the exact task ids); the completion marker is written only after all 40 valid pairs exist

stop_rule: Once all 40 tasks have valid raw/meta/retrieval evidence and the frozen-semantics evaluation completes, STOP and preserve the result whether positive, neutral or negative. No retrieval tuning, no prompt tuning, no reruns after observing results. Results enter the S5 common comparison.
not_allowed: retrieval parameter changes until performance improves
weakening path, syntax, timeout, cleanup or regression checks
